Questions

Answers, before you ask.

Does LocalLift work for a single salon?

Yes. LocalLift runs for you, so one salon gets the same weekly work without adding to the front desk.

Do you need our photos?

Your own photos work best. Share them with us and we will put them to work in your daily Google posts.

How do you handle a negative review?

Calmly and in your voice. We thank the client, acknowledge the concern and invite them to talk with you directly.

Will our hours and services stay correct online?

Site Read checks hours, services and prices across your website, your Google profile and AI answers every week, and we fix or flag what we find.
